elements.name: Bejeweled Conclave Trinket
elements.desc:
Bejeweled Conclave Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | An empty perfume bottle that smells faintly of longing

2 | Three love letters in the same handwriting, signed with different names

3 | A silk scarf with several hidden pockets

4 | The signature page from a contract

5 | A drinking glass carved with a comet

6 | A gaudy engagement ring with a fake gem

elements.name: Bringers of Cosmic Dawn Trinket
elements.desc:
Bringers of Cosmic Dawn Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | A razor-sharp, violet-tinted talon

2 | An uneven spyglass lens that casts flickering pale-green light

3 | A stone carved with stars in an unfamiliar constellation

4 | Fragments of a prophecy about flumphs

5 | A fern frond that twitches like a tentacle

6 | A small box containing a worm that won't die

elements.name: Covenant of the Grave Trinket
elements.desc:
Covenant of the Grave Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | A tin of grave dirt

2 | A self-sterilizing trephine

3 | A chapbook with illustrations of graveyards

4 | A zombie's twitching toe

5 | A small wreath of dried flowers in an old box

6 | A mysterious organ in a jar of amber fluid

elements.name: Crucible Keepers Trinket
elements.desc:
Crucible Keepers Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | A piece of metal pierced by a tornado-driven twig

2 | A tattered, salt-stained doll

3 | A chunk of volcanic glass

4 | Broken wind chimes

5 | A seashell blackened by a great fire

6 | Bark seared with lightning-shaped lines

elements.name: Horizon Weavers Trinket
elements.desc:
Horizon Weavers Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | A compass that spins lazily

2 | A map of a lost valley

3 | A chip of ice that never melts

4 | A ring inscribed "bring me home again"

5 | Wicker from the basket of a hot air balloon

6 | Four orange leaves with unfamiliar shapes

elements.name: Ninth Quill Trinket
elements.desc:
Ninth Quill Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | A long fake beard

2 | A fancy pen that never runs out of ink

3 | A bag of broken teeth

4 | A scrap of paper with several crossed-out passwords and the word "caiman" circled

5 | Two identical playing cards with unfamiliar suits

6 | A featureless mask with small eyeholes

elements.name: Phantasmic Circus Trinket
elements.desc:
Phantasmic Circus Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | An advertisement for a past circus performance, featuring your likeness

2 | A small tin of white greasepaint

3 | A green wire stem that produces an illusory flower for 1 minute when brandished dramatically

4 | A fine silk ribbon, two inches wide and nine feet long

5 | Bronze finger cymbals

6 | A battered top hat

elements.id: Gear:Seers of Sea and Sky Trinket (AU)
elements.name: Seers of Sea and Sky Trinket
elements.desc:
Seers of Sea and Sky Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | A piece of driftwood with natural whorls and gnarls that spell out your name

2 | A windsock

3 | A tide chart for an unfamiliar seashore

4 | A roll of seaweed with cryptic symbols written on it in octopus ink

5 | A small cog from a lighthouse's turning mechanism

6 | Four oddly shaped white feathers that fit together to form a perfect triangle

elements.name: Sheltering Hands Trinket
elements.desc:
Sheltering Hands Trinkets

1d6 | Trinket

1 | A tin of lotion to ease rashes

2 | A religious tract for an unfamiliar deity of healing

3 | A child's drawing of two parents smiling

4 | A utensil with a fork on one end and spoon on the other

5 | A pouch of sweet spices

6 | A windup toy soldier holding a large shield
